## 4500 - 4599

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4500 XCOMBO - Low C6+ molar mass</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04500">

This exception is generated when a source analysis record has a C6Plus Molar Mass that falls below the minimum requirement set up in Source Analysis Validations. For example, the minimum quantity for C6Plus Molar Mass is set to 1.5000 but the imported quantity for C6Plus Molar Mass is 1.0000 and exception 4500 is thrown.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04501">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04501">

For example, the maximum quantity for C6Plus Molar Mass is set to 5.0000 but the imported quantity for C6Plus Molar Mass is 5.5000 and exception 4501 is thrown.

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04531">

</div>
